decisions.reason: Monitoring all 3.3V-rail current does not change the defined power sources, diode OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
The standalone USB supply already powers the complete 3.3V rail; the monitoring-coverage clarification does not change its source, capacity, activation condition, or powered scope.
The clarification concerns INA219 coverage on the 3.3V rail and does not alter the addressable LEDs' 5V supply, switching, or logic-level handling.
Rail-current monitoring coverage does not change the panel controls, connector usage, button placement, or GPIO mappings.
The source decision does not add, remove, or alter any connector or connector-count requirement.
Requiring INA219 to monitor all rail current does not change the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source concerns monitoring of the main-board 3.3V rail, not the switched 5V boost supply, its enable control, or its loads.
Current-monitor coverage does not affect the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The INA219 coverage clarification does not change the battery connector, pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
Monitoring all 3.3V-rail current imposes no stated change to any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The rail-current monitoring decision does not alter the battery-charge indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor values, or LED configuration.
The source does not change the interboard connectors, carried power signals, pin-order policy, or matching-numbering requirement.
